privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the esys.pro website (Evolution Systems) collects, why it is needed, and how we handle it. By using the website you agree to the terms of this policy.

s1.title: 1. General
s1.text: The esys.pro website is operated by Evolution Systems, a digital agency based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. For any questions about data processing, write to hi{'@'}esys.pro.

s2.title: 2. What data we collect
s2.text:
Contact form data: name, email, subject and message text - only what you provide yourself.
Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages visited - collected automatically by the analytics service in anonymized form.
Cookies: small files in your browser required for the website to function and for statistics.

s3.title: 3. Purposes of processing
s3.text: We use the data to respond to your inquiries and messages, to improve the website's performance and content, and to keep anonymized visit statistics. We do not use your data for mailings without separate consent.

s4.title: 4. Cookies
s4.text: Cookies are used to remember your language choice, your decision in the consent banner, and to collect statistics. You can decline non-essential cookies in the banner or disable cookies in your browser settings - the website will keep working.

s5.title: 5. Third parties
s5.text: Anonymized visit statistics may be processed by a web analytics service (Yandex Metrica). Contact form data is sent to our server and is never sold or shared with third parties, except where required by law.

s6.title: 6. Data retention and your rights
s6.text: Inquiry data is kept for as long as needed to handle your request. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data - write to hi{'@'}esys.pro and we will respond within a reasonable time.

about.intro: We are a digital development studio from Tashkent. We design and build turnkey websites, mobile applications and CRM systems - handling the entire process from the first meeting to launch and support.

process.title: How we work
process.subtitle: A transparent process with no surprises - you always know what stage the project is at.

s1.title: Brief and analysis
s1.text: We dive into your business: goals, audience, competitors. We define the requirements and agree on the scope of work.

s2.title: Design
s2.text: We design the structure and interface, show the mockups, gather feedback and polish until it's right.

s3.title: Development
s3.text: We write clean, fast code and regularly show intermediate results - no black boxes.

s4.title: Launch
s4.text: We test on real devices, set up hosting and analytics, and take the product to production.

s5.title: Support
s5.text: We don't disappear after launch: we grow the product, add features and keep it stable.

v1.title: Transparency
v1.text: Honest timelines and budget. You see the project status at every stage.

v2.title: Quality
v2.text: We don't hand over work until we're proud of it ourselves. Every project is our calling card.

v3.title: Results
v3.text: We build not “just a website” but a tool that solves real business problems.

cta.title: Ready to discuss your project?
cta.text: Tell us about your idea - we'll propose a solution, timeline and estimate for free.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to what we're asked most often. Didn't find yours - drop us a line.

q1.question: How much does a website cost?
q1.answer: It depends on the scope: a landing page, a corporate site and an online store require different amounts of work. After the brief we prepare a fixed-price estimate for free - no hidden extras.

q2.question: How long does a project take?
q2.answer: A landing page from 2 weeks, a corporate website from 4–6 weeks, a mobile app or CRM from 2–3 months. Exact timelines are fixed once the requirements are agreed.

q3.question: What do you need from us to start?
q3.answer: A description of your idea and goals is enough. Materials - copy, photos, logo - can be prepared together with us: we'll help with structure and content.

q4.question: Do you support the project after launch?
q4.answer: Yes. We offer technical support, feature development and content maintenance. Terms are tailored to your project.

q5.question: Do you work with clients outside Uzbekistan?
q5.answer: Yes, we work remotely with clients from any country. Calls, reports and demos are held online at a time convenient for you.

q6.question: Can you improve an existing website or app?
q6.answer: Yes. We'll audit your current solution and propose a plan - from targeted improvements to a full redesign.
